definition: Stable city directory identifier.
2020 city-limit geography; New York includes all five boroughs.
block = populated Census blocks; tract = populated city-limit tract portions. These are separate networks.
Inclusive great-circle distance cutoff in kilometers, with Earth radius6378.1km; distinct nodes only.
All positive-population city nodes, before excluding geographic isolates from the SSI denominator.
All 2020 city residents; includes those in geographic isolates or other/unclassified nodes.
Category assigned to nodes by the largest of White-alone, Black-alone, Hispanic-any-race, Asian-alone counts. Counts themselves overlap; assigned node labels do not.
All city residents in this Census category, irrespective of which category their node was assigned.
group_population/city_population, fraction0–1. Uses all residents, not the fraction of assigned nodes or only eligible nodes.
Nodes assigned to the category, including geographic isolates.
Assigned nodes whose category population share is <=0.5. The dominant-category rule can assign a plurality without a strict majority.
Assigned nodes with no other populated node within the radius. Excluded from the SSI denominator, following author code.
Assigned nodes with at least one neighbor of any category. Denominator for city SSI component-size weighting.
Eligible assigned nodes with no same-category neighbor. They remain in the SSI denominator and have localSSI0.
Sum over same-category components of component_eigenvalue*component_size/eligible_assigned_node_count. R_ij=1/all-neighbor-degree; restrict R without renormalizing. Undefined if denominator0.
Number of eligible assigned-category components, including singleton nodes with only other-category neighbors.
Largest eligible same-category component node count; zero if no eligible assigned nodes.
Maximum absolute residual |B_C*v_C-lambda_C*v_C| over components. Numerical error, not a segregation score.
ok = at least one eligible assigned node; undefined_no_eligible_assigned_nodes = city SSI and adjustments are blank/NaN.
Requested population-share adjustment SSI-K. No division. The paper simulated-null adjustment is different and is not computed.
(SSI-K)/(1-K), using the all-city resident fractionK. Negative values retained; undefined forK1 or undefinedSSI.
Number of unordered neighboring pairs, including all categories. No self-links.
All city nodes with no geographic neighbors at this radius, regardless of assigned category.
Population of all geographic-isolate nodes. Included in city and group counts used forK.
Mean degree over all populated nodes, including degree-zero nodes.
